strings.support_methods_subtitle: Paw ɔkwan a wopɛ sɛ wode ntoboa ma. Ntoboa biara tua ho ka tẽẽ wɔ download, hosting, ne test hardware.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis taa de firmwares foforo ma agodifo te sɛ Y1 (a ɛde n’ani si board nsakrae a ahintaw te sɛ 6.0, 7.0, ne 8.0) a ɛbubu mfiri dedaw no komm. Nea enye koraa no, wɔn wɛbsaet no ma kɔkɔbɔ zero ne zero kwan a wɔfa so kɔ firmwares a na ɛyɛ adwuma dedaw no so na ama wɔasan anya ahoɔden afi tebea a wɔde birikisi ayɛ mu. Updater ne Community Firmware adwuma no fa asinasin no: yɛkora agyapade stock ROM biara so, yɛhwɛ wo hardware nsakrae no mu ankasa, na yɛma wo player no yɛ adwuma dwoodwoo.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma kɔ so a, mpɔtam hɔfo tu anammɔn.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Rescuing Broken Players: Ahobammɔ nhwehwɛmu hwɛ hu sɛ updates foforo mfa birikisi hardware dedaw no da.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Mfitiase adwumayɛbea firmwares a wɔaboaboa ano awie Innioasis a wɔapopa.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Nnwinnade a ɛhyerɛn a edi mũ ma macOS, Linux, ne Windows nyinaa.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Automatic board detection enti bere nyinaa wubenya package a ɛfata.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Wo mfiri a wobɛbɔ ho ban afi hardware afiri a ɛyɛ komm ne nsakrae a asɛe ho.
strings.support_story_2_body: Innioasis softwea a ɛyɛ aban de a wobɛhwehwɛ no taa kyerɛ sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ Google Drive link ahorow a ne bere atwam, Baidu mununkum mu kyɛfa a awu, ne ahintasɛm zip fael ahorow a nnwinnade a ɛhyerɛn biara nni nhyiam ahorow ase. Yɛkyekyeree download network a wotumi de ho to so, a ɛde ne ho a ɛwɔ SHA-256 mudi mu kura a wɔagye atom, update notifications, ne step-by-step guided installs. Wo ntoboa no sie tẽẽ de downloads ne hosting a ɛma eyi tumi yɛ yiye nnɔnhwerew 24 da biara, nnafua 365 afe biara.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Google Drives a asɛe biara nni hɔ. No guess-work biara nni hɔ. Firmware a ɛyɛ adwuma kɛkɛ.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Nneɛma a wɔtwe ntɛmntɛm, tẽẽ a enni anohyeto biara a wɔde bɛtwe anaasɛ link a awu.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Nya kɔkɔ bere a mpɔtam hɔfo foforo a wɔayi no adi anaasɛ wɔasiesie no akɔ fam no.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Nneɛma a wɔde aniwa hu a emu da hɔ no nantew wo wɔ bɔtn biara a wobɛmia mu.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Kasa Ahorow Mpɔtam: Wɔde Borɔfo, China, German, Spania, Franse & Japan kasa na ɛyɛ mpɔtam hɔfo koraa.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm, a wɔagye atom a wubetumi de wo ho ato so ankasa.
strings.support_story_3_body: Stock factory software no twetwe nea wo Y1 anaa Y2 hardware betumi ayɛ no ani nkutoo. Yɛn mpɔtam hɔfo de Rockbox, custom operating systems a emu yɛ hare, audiophile codec playback, ne custom themes baa nkwa mu. Yɛtɔ honam fam hardware nsakraeɛ fi yɛn kotokuo mu de sɔ hwɛ, yɛyɛ reverse engineer, na yɛhwɛ sɛ instɔlehyɛn biara a ɛwɔ hɔ no yɛ nokware anaa. Supporting Updater tẽẽ de sika ma saa sɔhwɛ units yi na ɛma custom firmware nkɔso ntɛmntɛm.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Wo Innioasis player no tumi nyinaa a wobɛbue.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox a Klik Baako: Audiophile a wɔbɔ ne nsɛmti a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a wɔde ahyɛ mu wɔ sikɔne kakraa bi mu.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Battery nkɔso, UI a ɛho tew, ne nnɛyi ɔdio codec mmoa.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Yɛsɔ hwɛ wɔ honam fam mfiri ankasa so ansa na yɛayi ɔdan biara adi.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% free, kokoamsɛm-di kan software a enni dawurubɔ anaa tracking.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Rockbox, dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ a emu yɛ hare a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ, ne audiophile ahofadie a wɔde bɛba.
strings.support_story_4_body: Sɛ adwumakuw bi a wɔyɛ hardware kɔ wɔn mfiri a edi hɔ no so a, wogyae mfiri dedaw ahorow no. Innioasis mma Linux mmoa biara, nsakraeɛ ho nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee biara mma, na ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw biara nni hɔ a wobɛfa so asan anya bio bere a instɔlehyɛn bi adi nkogu. Updater wɔ hɔ efisɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔn ani gye ho no tow nnwom a wɔbɔ no yiye koraa gu. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ntoboa 100% kɔ tẽẽ wɔ saa adwinnadeɛ yi a wɔbɛma wɔabue ama obiara no mu.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Boa yɛn ma yɛnyɛ nea Innioasis nyɛ.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Proven recovery flows mpo bere a mfiri pow sɛ wɔbɛbɔ.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: MediaTek a ɛboa koraa a ɛrehyerɛn wɔ Linux distros so.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Nsɛm a wɔayi no adi a ɛkɔ akyiri sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubehu nea ɛsakra no yiye.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kɔfe biara ma nneɛma a wɔkora so no bue na obiara nnye hwee.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Firmware a wɔkora so a mpɔtam hɔfo de di dwuma a ɛma wo mfiri nkɔ mmeae a wɔtow nneɛma gu.
